narr: Slow moving thunderstorms over the Panama City area resulted in 2 to 3 inches of rain falling in just 1 hour. Several roads were flooded.
ev: Several roadways were reported to be underwater across the Panama City area due to 2 to 3 inches of rain falling in 1 hour.
lsr: EMERGENCY SERVICES REPORTED MANY ROADWAYS UNDERWATER ACROSS PANAMA CITY.
